name: Primate Panic!
summary:
Embark on a chilling journey into the heart of darkness with "Primate Panic," a spine-tingling horror game that explores the eerie mysteries of a long-forgotten research facility. Unravel the secrets hidden within the shadows as you navigate the twisted corridors, plagued by the echoes of haunting experiments gone awry.
